items.title: The Chief Rabbi Who Lost His Soul
items.excerpt: An opinion piece by Anton Harber criticising Chief Rabbi Warren Goldstein's public positions, published on the JDI website.

items.title: Statement on Jewish Report's Platforming of Joel Pollak
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on the Jewish Report giving a platform to Joel Pollak.

items.title: Statement for International Holocaust Memorial Day
items.excerpt: JDI's statement marking the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz and International Holocaust Memorial Day.

items.title: Statement on Elon Musk's Nazi Salute
items.excerpt: JDI's response to Elon Musk's gesture at a public event, widely condemned as a Nazi salute.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Ceasefire
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on the ceasefire agreement in Gaza, calling for its full implementation and a path to a permanent end to the conflict.

items.title: JDI Statement on Netanyahu Government's Sanctions Against Haaretz
items.excerpt: In solidarity with Haaretz — JDI condemns the Netanyahu government's punitive sanctions against the independent Israeli newspaper.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Ongoing Violence in Israel-Palestine
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on the October 2023 attacks and the outbreak of war in Gaza — mourning all civilian deaths and calling for a negotiated path to peace.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Passing of Key Judicial Overhaul Law
items.excerpt: JDI condemns the Netanyahu government's passage of legislation undermining the Israeli Supreme Court's power — a critical blow to Israeli democracy.

items.title: JDI Statement on Nakba Day: 75th Anniversary of the Catastrophe
items.excerpt: Marking the 75th anniversary of the Nakba, JDI acknowledges the Palestinian catastrophe of 1948 and calls for recognition of Palestinian rights and history.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Mass Protests Averting a Coup (For Now)
items.excerpt: JDI's response to the mass Israeli protests against judicial overhaul, welcoming civil society resistance to the erosion of democratic norms.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Threat to South African Rural Democracy
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on proposed legislation threatening rural democratic structures and local governance in South Africa.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Legislative Assault on Israeli Democracy
items.excerpt: JDI condemns the Netanyahu coalition's systematic legislative attack on Israel's democratic institutions and independent judiciary.

items.title: JDI Statement on Escalation of Violence and Tragic Killings in Israel-Palestine
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on a wave of deadly violence in Israel-Palestine, condemning the killing of civilians on all sides and calling for de-escalation.

items.title: JDI Statement on New Israeli Far-Right Coalition
items.excerpt: JDI responds to the formation of the most right-wing government in Israeli history, warning of the consequences for Palestinians and Israeli democracy.

items.title: JDI Statement on 25th Knesset Election Results
items.excerpt: JDI's response to the Israeli election results, expressing alarm at the rise of the extreme right and what it means for prospects of peace.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Rise of the Religious Zionist Party
items.excerpt: JDI condemns the growing influence of the Religious Zionist Party and its openly racist, anti-democratic platform ahead of Israeli elections.

items.title: JDI Statement on Designation of Palestinian Civil Society Organisations as Terrorist Organisations
items.excerpt: JDI condemns Israel's designation of six leading Palestinian human rights organisations as terrorist entities, calling it an attack on civil society and international humanitarian law.

items.title: JDI Denounces Likud Political Agreement with Extremist Parties
items.excerpt: JDI denounces Netanyahu's Likud party for entering into electoral agreements with parties that espouse racism, Jewish supremacy, and violent extremism.

items.title: JDI Welcomes the New Israeli Government
items.excerpt: JDI cautiously welcomes the formation of a new Israeli government without Netanyahu, while noting that the occupation must still be addressed.

items.title: JDI Statement on the Violent Deterioration of the Conflict in Israel and Gaza
items.excerpt: JDI's statement on the May 2021 Gaza war, condemning the bombardment of Gaza and calling for an immediate ceasefire and political solution.

items.title: The Silence of Our Leadership is Deafening
items.excerpt: JDI's open letter calling out the silence of South African Jewish communal leadership in the face of Israeli government actions that contradict Jewish values.
